unreg:all_star_weekend_events.blueprint_mechanism: Count = minutes times per-minute rate, modulated by opponent and game state and with distribution shape from overdispersion. Rates differ by stat (threes: attempts times make probability; steals/blocks: low-count Poisson-like; FT: attempts times FT%). Availability of teammates and minutes dominate the variance.

In the two-round contest, players attempt to score as many points as possible from multiple 3-point locations within 70 seconds. The top three scorers from the first round advance to the championship round, where the highest score determines the winner.

KXNBAALLSTARGAME.rules_primary: If Team World wins the 2026 Pro Basketball All-Star Tournament, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXNBAALLSTARGAME.rules_secondary:
The Pro Basketball All-Star Game will feature a round-robin mini-tournament with four 12-minute games. The matchups are as follows: 

Game 1: USA Stars vs. World 

Game 2: USA Stripes vs. winning team of Game 1 

Game 3: USA Stripes vs. losing team of Game 1 

Game 4: All-Star Championship (top two teams from round-robin play) 

If all three teams finish 1-1 after the round-robin games, the first tiebreaker will be point differential across each team’s two games.
KXNBAALLSTARGAME.title: Will Team World win the 2026 All-Star Tournament?

unreg:series_cumulative_points.blueprint_mechanism: Points are possessions times points per possession for each team. Pace is a joint property of both teams and lineups, efficiency depends on opponent defense, shot-making luck and free-throw volume, and late-game script (garbage time, intentional fouls) plus overtime shifts the tail. Availability changes both pace and efficiency, so decision-time injury vintage matters.
